description: Replace lines `from` to `to` of a file with `content`. The result must parse and pass the repo's formatter, or the file is left unchanged and the proposed lines are shown. Returns the edited lines with 5 lines of context.

content.description: New lines, without line numbers; empty deletes the range.

file.description: File path relative to the repo root.

to.description: Last line to replace, inclusive; `from - 1` inserts before `from`.

name: edit

description: Find files by name pattern. At most 50 results, otherwise asks to narrow.

dir.description: Directory to search, relative to the repo root (default: root).

pattern.description: File name, `*` matches any run of characters (e.g. `test_*.py`).

name: find_file

description: Show the 100 lines around a line of the open file.
name: goto

description: Open a file and show 100 numbered lines around `line`, with the number of lines hidden above and below.

file.description: File path relative to the repo root.

line.description: 1-based line to show near the middle of the window (default: 1).

name: open

description: Show the next 100 lines of the open file.
name: scroll_down

description: Show the previous 100 lines of the open file.
name: scroll_up

description: Find definitions by name. Returns kind, signature, file and line range; at most 50 results, otherwise asks to narrow.

name.description:
Name of a function, type, trait, class…; `Type::method` or
`Class.method` for a method.

name: search_symbol

description: Find lines containing a literal text. Returns file and line; at most 50 results, otherwise asks to narrow.

dir.description: Directory to search, relative to the repo root (default: root).

name: search_text
